source_text: Ὃν τρόπον δὲ καὶ ἀνεθήκαμεν ἑαυτοὺς τῷ θεῷ καινοποιηθέντες διὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἐξηγησόμεθα, ὅπως μὴ τοῦτο παραλιπόντες δόξωμεν πονηρεύειν τι ἐν τῇ ἐξηγήσει. Ὅσοι ἂν πεισθῶσι καὶ πιστεύωσιν ἀληθῆ ταῦτα τὰ ὑφ᾿ ἡμῶν διδασκόμενα καὶ λεγόμενα εἶναι, καὶ βιοῦν οὕτως δύνασθαι ὑπισχνῶνται, εὔχεσθαί τε καὶ αἰτεῖν νηστεύοντες παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν προημαρτημένων ἄφεσιν διδάσκονται, ἡμῶν συνευχομένων καὶ συννηστευόντων αὐτοῖς. Ἔπειτα ἄγονται ὑφ᾿ ἡμῶν, ἔνθα ὕδωρ ἐστί, καὶ τρόπον ἀναγεννήσεως, ὃν καὶ ἡμεῖς αὐτοὶ ἀνεγεννήθημεν, ἀναγεννῶνται· ἐπ᾿ ὀνόματος γὰρ τοῦ πατρὸς τῶν ὅλων καὶ δεσπότου θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ πνεῦματος ἁγίου τὸ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι τότε λουτρὸν ποιοῦνται. Καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς εἶπεν· Ἂν μὴ ἀναγεννηθῆτε, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν.“ Ὅτι δὲ καὶ ἀδύνατον εἰς τὰς μήτρας τῶν τεκουσῶν τοὺς ἅπαξ γεννωμένους ἐμβῆναι, φανερὸν πᾶσίν ἐστι. Καὶ διὰ Ἡσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου, ὡς προεγράψαμεν, εἴρηται, τίνα τρόπον φεύξονται τὰς ἁμαρτίας οἱ ἁμαρτήσαντες καὶ μετανοοῦντες. Ἐλέχθη δὲ οὕτως· Λούσασθε, καθαροὶ γένεσθε, ἀφέλετε τὰς πονηρίας ἀπὸ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν, μάθετε καλὸν ποιεῖν, κρίνατε ὀρφανῷ καὶ δικαιώσατε χήραν, καὶ δεῦτε καὶ διαλεχθῶμεν, λέγει κύριος· καὶ ἐὰν ὦσιν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ὑμῶν ὡς φοινικοῦν, ὡσεὶ ἔριον λευκανῶ, καὶ ἐὰν ὦσιν ὡς κόκκινον, ὡς χιόνα λευκανῶ. Ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εἰσακούσητέ μου, μάχαιρα ὑμᾶς κατέδεται· τὸ γὰρ στόμα κυρίου ἐλάλησε ταῦτα“. Καὶ λόγον δὲ εἰς τοῦτο παρὰ τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐμάθομεν τοῦτον. Ἐπειδὴ τὴν πρώτην γένεσιν ἡμῶν ἀγνοοῦντες κατ᾿ ἀνάγκην γεγεννήμεθα ἐξ ὑγρᾶς σπορᾶς κατὰ μῖξιν τὴν τῶν γονέων πρὸς ἀλλήλους καὶ ἐν ἔθεσι φαύλοις καὶ πονηραῖς ἀναστροφαῖς γεγόναμεν, ὅπως μὴ ἀνάγκης τέκνα μηδὲ ἀγνοίας μένωμεν ἀλλὰ προαιρέσεως καὶ ἐπιστήμης, ἀφέσεώς ἁμαρτιῶν ὧν προημάρτομεν τύχωμεν, ἐν τῷ ὕδατι ἐπονομάζεται τῷ ἑλομένῳ ἀναγεννηθῆναι καὶ μετανοήσαντι ἐπὶ τοῖς ἡμαρτημένοις τὸ τοῦ πατρὸς τῶν ὅλων καὶ δεσπότου θεοῦ ὄνομα, αὐτὸ τοῦτο μόνον ἐπιλέγοντος τοῦ τὸν λουσόμενον ἄγοντος ἐπὶ τὸ λουτρόν. Ὄνομα γὰρ τῷ ἀῤῥήτῳ θεῷ οὐδεὶς ἔχει εἰπεῖν· εἰ δέ τις τολμήσειεν εἶναι λέγειν, μέμηνε τὴν ἄσωτον μανίαν. Καλεῖται δὲ τοῦτο τὸ λουτρὸν φωτισμός, ὡς φωτιζομένων τὴν διάνοιαν τῶν ταῦτα μανθανόντων. Καὶ ἐπ᾿ ὀνόματος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, τοῦ σταυρωθέντος ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου, καὶ ἐπ᾿ ὀνόματος πνεύματος ἁγίου, ὃ διὰ τῶν προφητῶν προεκήρυξε τὰ κατὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν πάντα, ὁ φωτιζόμενος λούεται.
pass_a_gloss: We will explain in what manner we have dedicated ourselves to God, being renewed through Christ, so that we may not seem to be doing something evil in the explanation by leaving this out. Those who are persuaded and believe that the things we teach and say are true, and who promise to be able to live in this way, are taught to pray and ask for forgiveness from God for past sins while fasting, with us praying and fasting together with them. Then they are led by us to where there is water, and they are reborn in the manner of rebirth, which we also were reborn in; for they make the washing in the water in the name of the Father of all and Master God and our Savior Jesus Christ and the Holy Spirit. For Christ said, 'If you are not reborn, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven.' It is clear to everyone that it is impossible for those who have been born once to enter the wombs of their mothers. And through the prophet Isaiah, as we wrote before, it is said how those who have sinned and repented will escape their sins. It was said, 'Wash yourselves, become clean, remove the evil deeds from your souls, learn to do good, judge the orphan and justify the widow, and come and let us reason together,' says the Lord; 'and if your sins are like scarlet, I will make them white like wool, and if they are like crimson, I will make them white like snow.' But if you do not listen to me, a sword will devour you; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things. We have also learned this word from the apostles. Since we were born unaware of our first birth, having been born from moist seed according to the mixture of our parents and having become evil and wicked in our behavior, so that we may not remain children of necessity or ignorance but of choice and knowledge, we obtain forgiveness of sins which we previously committed; in the water, the name of the Father of all and Master God is invoked upon the one who chooses to be reborn and has repented of past sins, the one who leads the person to be washed only saying this name. For no one has the ability to speak the name of the unutterable God; but if someone dares to say it, they have a reckless madness. This washing is called enlightenment, as the mind of those who learn these things is enlightened. And the one being enlightened is washed in the name of Jesus Christ, who was crucified under Pontius Pilate, and in the name of the Holy Spirit, who proclaimed through the prophets all things concerning Jesus.
pass_b_english: We will explain the manner in which we dedicated ourselves to God, having been renewed through Christ, so that by not omitting this we may not appear to be doing something evil in our explanation. Those who are persuaded and believe that the things we teach and say are true, and who promise that they can live accordingly, are taught to pray and to ask God for the forgiveness of past sins while fasting, with us praying and fasting together with them. Then they are led by us to where water is, and they are reborn in the very manner of rebirth by which we ourselves were reborn; for in the water they undergo the washing in the name of the Father of all and Master God, and of our Savior Jesus Christ, and of the Holy Spirit. For Christ said, ‘Unless you are reborn, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven’ (John 3:5). It is clear to everyone that it is impossible for those who have been born once to enter the wombs of those who bore them. And through the prophet Isaiah, as we wrote before, it is declared how those who have sinned and repented will escape their sins (Isaiah 1:16–20). It was said: ‘Wash yourselves, become clean, remove the evil deeds from your souls, learn to do good, judge the orphan and justify the widow, and come and let us reason together,’ says the Lord; ‘and if your sins are like scarlet, I will make them white like wool, and if they are like crimson, I will make them white like snow. But if you do not listen to me, a sword will devour you; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things.’ We also learned this word from the apostles. Since we were born unaware of our first birth, having been born from moist seed according to the mixture of our parents, and having become evil and wicked in our behavior, so that we may not remain children of necessity or ignorance but of choice and knowledge, we obtain forgiveness of the sins which we previously committed; in the water the name of the Father of all and Master God is invoked upon the one who chooses to be reborn and has repented of past sins, the one who leads the person to the washing only saying this name. For no one has the ability to speak the name of the unutterable God; but if anyone dares to say it, they display a reckless madness. This washing is called enlightenment, as the mind of those who learn these things is enlightened. And the one being enlightened is washed in the name of Jesus Christ, who was crucified under Pontius Pilate, and in the name of the Holy Spirit, who proclaimed through the prophets all things concerning Jesus.
